integrity: Analytical proof and independently run finite/analytic numerical consistency code are supplied. No independent external verification or scholarly priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The new claim covers only conditional three-site joint probabilities during 0<t<1 on an infinite one-dimensional iid one-attempt hard-exclusion lattice. Its t=1 gap specialization is already implied by published pair correlations and is provided only as a consistency check. No higher multi-gap law is claimed.
title: Strict positive transient three-site Palm dependence in nearest-neighbor adsorption
